R2075.a: No W29 protein similar to human MMUT or P. freudenreichii MutB at E<=1e-5; best at E<=10 is E=0.5 over 7-26% of the query. No KEGG yli gene for EC 5.4.99.2.
R2075.b: Cytosolic in the model (the animal enzyme is mitochondrial).
R2075.sources: UniProt REST search rhea:22888-22891 reviewed (opened); UniProt CLIB122 sweep for MCM/B12-binding domains (agent): none; Park et al. 2018 Biotechnol Biofuels 11:158 (Europe PMC XML, agent): propionyl-CoA catabolised via the methylcitrate cycle; Uchiyama et al. 1982 Eur J Biochem, PubMed 7117251 abstract (agent): methylcitrate-cycle enzymes in mitochondria
R2075.flags: No paper states that Y. lipolytica lacks MCM; the absence rests on annotation and this BLAST. The documented propionate route is the methylcitrate cycle.

R2076.a: Nearest characterised activity is the ATP-dependent malonyl/methylmalonyl-CoA ligase (human ACSF3, A. thaliana AAE13). Best W29 hit YALI1E15835g (29%) is the reciprocal best hit of oxalyl-CoA synthetase (S. pombe 58.6%, S. cerevisiae PCS60 51.7%): a different function. Other hits are generic acyl-CoA ligases.
R2076.flags: As written, methylmalonate + CoA -> methylmalonyl-CoA + H2O has no ATP; a thioester-forming condensation without an energy source is implausible (inferred, not checked against a deltaG source).

R23.a: YALI1D01431g is the reciprocal best hit of S. cerevisiae BAT1/BAT2 (63.6/65.9%); YALI1E24922g of ARO8 (50.2%); YALI1C06681g is ARO9-like (29-31%, reciprocal best S. pombe aromatic aminotransferase); YALI1F26574g is a second BCAT-like gene (38%, not in the model).
R23.b: Cytosolic. S. cerevisiae Bat2 (the glutamate-using one) is cytosolic; Bat1 is matrix. Y. lipolytica has one main BAT gene; its localization was not checked.
R23.c: KMTB has one producer (R10, methionine salvage).
R23.paralog_note: YALI1E24922g (ARO8 reciprocal best hit, 50.2%) is a tier-C addition: Aro8/Aro9 KMTB transamination is shown with aromatic donors, not glutamate. YALI1C06681g (ARO9-like) and YALI1F26574g (second BCAT-like, not in model) are weaker.
R23.genes_named: YALI1D01431g; verified name: none verified in Y. lipolytica; branched-chain amino acid aminotransferase (reciprocal best hit of S. cerevisiae BAT1 63.6% / BAT2 65.9%); evidence B: S. cerevisiae deletion genetics (Pirkov et al. 2008) + reciprocal BLAST. YALI1E24922g; none verified; aromatic aminotransferase (ARO8 orthologue); C for this reaction.
R23.sources: Pirkov et al. 2008 FEBS J 275:4111, PubMed 18625006 abstract (opened by me via E-utilities and by agent 2; full text 403, unread): Aro8, Aro9, Bat1, Bat2 'seemed to be the main enzymes'; 'Bat2p ... used proline, lysine, tyrosine and glutamate as amino donors'; method: growth tests and MTA levels in deletion mutants. UniProt P53090/P38840/P38891/P47176 (agent 2): KMTB reactions ECO:0000269 for ARO8/ARO9, ECO:0000305 for BAT1/BAT2; Bat1 mitochondrial matrix, Bat2 cytoplasm.
R23.flags: YALI1D01431g (BAT) also carries R26/R27, 2-isopropyl-3-oxosuccinate decarboxylation, which is not a transamination; review outside scope.

R333.a: No W29 protein similar to A. oryzae GtaA, human GLS or E. coli GlsA1 at E<=1e-5; sub-threshold hits to human GLS (E=2e-4) cover 7-17% of it. No KEGG yli gene for EC 3.5.1.2 as a standalone glutaminase.
R333.flags: Model EC list (1.4.1.13, 1.4.1.14, 1.4.7.1, 2.6.1.85) names glutamate synthases, not glutaminase (annotation issue).

R517.a: Aldehyde-dehydrogenase family only: E. coli AldA hits 12 W29 ALDHs at 25-36%; the top ones (YALI1E00588g, YALI1C04093g, YALI1F06858g, YALI1D34353g) have reciprocal best hits S. cerevisiae Ald4/Ald5 or other broad ALDHs, not lactaldehyde dehydrogenase.
R517.paralog_note: Paralogue-ambiguous: no specificity data separate the ALDHs.

R721.a: No SAT orthologue: the only hit, YALI1A15079g (E. coli CysE, 37.7% over 18%), is a hexapeptide-repeat acetyltransferase whose reciprocal best hits are 'putative acetyltransferase' and sophorolipid acetyltransferase. S. pombe 'putative SAT' gave no hit.

R984.a: YALI1F34187g is the reciprocal best hit of S. cerevisiae SDT1 (50.0% over 78%; PHM8 third, 42%); it already carries UMP, CMP, dCMP and dTMP nucleotidases (R58, R56, R981, R983) and R1760.
R984.paralog_note: Single SDT1/PHM8-family gene in W29. No source opened shows dUMP activity for Sdt1 or Phm8; the model's dCMP and dTMP nucleotidases on the same gene (R981, R983) are equally untested (outside scope).
R984.genes_named: YALI1F34187g; verified name: none verified; HAD-family pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase (SDT1 orthologue); reciprocal BLAST only for dUMP
R984.sources: Agent 2: Nakanishi & Sekimizu 2002 JBC PubMed 11934891 abstract ('specifically dephosphorylated 5'-UMP and 5'-CMP'; full text unread); Kuznetsova et al. 2015 JBC PMC4513125 full text (Sdt1 kcat/Km UMP, CMP, XMP, NMN; no dUMP, dCMP or dTMP); Xu et al. 2013 Mol Syst Biol PMC4039369 full text (Phm8 broad NMP nucleotidase; no deoxynucleotides)
